acceptance_tests: ERC run reports 0 errors and 0 warnings (baseline 10 errors / 8 warnings resolved)
DRC run against generic_two_layer profile reports 0 errors, 0 warnings, and 0 unrouted nets (baseline 6 errors / 14 warnings resolved)
Netlist-to-layout consistency check passes with no mismatches
Measure +3V3 rail at TMP102 VCC and ESP32 3V3 pins: 3.135-3.465 V (3.3 V +/-5%) under idle and WiFi TX load
Verify with continuity test that U2.1 is on +3V3 and U2.2 is on GND
I2C bus scan detects TMP102 at address 0x48; oscilloscope confirms SDA/SCL rise times within I2C spec at 100 kHz and 400 kHz
Read TMP102 temperature register over I2C from ESP32 firmware and confirm a plausible ambient reading
Verify board outline in layout is exactly 110 x 65 mm (35,35 to 145,100) and no courtyard extends outside it
Verify stackup is exactly 2 copper layers with continuous GND pour on the bottom layer under USB and I2C routing
Verify USB D+/D- routed as a length-matched differential pair (mismatch <= 1 mm)
Confirm BOM, Gerber/drill fabrication outputs, and assembly documentation are generated and complete
constraints: All logic operates at 3.3 V from a single regulated rail
USB is the sole power input; input current limited to 500 mA unless negotiated
Board outline fixed at 110 x 65 mm (35,35 to 145,100); all placement and routing must stay inside it
Propose changes only at this stage; no project files modified
TMP102 power connectivity gaps (U2.1 to +3V3, U2.2 to GND) must be resolved in the schematic stage
ERC baseline (10 errors, 8 warnings) and DRC baseline (6 errors, 14 warnings) must be driven to zero

interfaces.type: I2C (TMP102 temperature sensor, address 0x48, SDA=GPIO21, SCL=GPIO22, 4.7 kOhm pull-ups)
USB 2.0 full-speed data (J1 D+/D- to U1.USB_D+/USB_D-, differential pair)

power.input: USB 5 V VBUS via connector J1 (sole power input), regulated down to 3.3 V by an added 5 V-to-3.3 V regulator

requirements.source: project request: 'USB-C powered ESP32 board'; pin table J1.VBUS
requirements.statement: The board shall be powered from the USB connector J1 with 5 V nominal VBUS as its sole power input.

requirements.source: project request: 'Keep the logic at 3.3 V'; workflow: schematic_engineer step
requirements.statement: A 5 V-to-3.3 V regulator shall be added, generating the +3V3 rail from VBUS so all logic operates out of the 3.3 V rail.

requirements.source: derived: standard LDO tolerance for ESP32 and TMP102 supply ranges
requirements.statement: The +3V3 rail shall be regulated to 3.3 V +/-5% under all load conditions at that regulator output.

requirements.source: derived: ESP32-WROOM-32 datasheet peak ~370 mA plus margin; USB default budget
requirements.statement: The total 3.3 V load budget (ESP32-WROOM-32 WiFi TX peaks plus TMP102) shall not exceed 500 mA under all load conditions.

requirements.source: derived from PWR-004 with 20% margin
requirements.statement: The regulator shall be rated for at least 600 mA output so the 3.3 V rail supplies ESP32 peaks and I2C pull-ups with margin.

requirements.source: USB 2.0 specification default current limit
requirements.statement: Input current drawn from USB shall not exceed 500 mA unless higher current is negotiated.

requirements.source: derived: regulator stability and ESP32 transient load practice
requirements.statement: Bulk capacitance of at least 10 uF shall be provided on the input and output of the 3.3 V rail at the regulator.

requirements.source: derived: standard decoupling practice; workflow: schematic_engineer step
requirements.statement: Each active device power pin (U1.3V3, U2.VCC) shall have a 100 nF decoupling capacitor placed within 3 mm of the pin.

requirements.source: design context nets: +3V3 lists only U1.1, U1.8; workflow: 'resolve missing +3V3/GND connectivity'
requirements.statement: TMP102 U2.VCC (pin 1) shall be connected to the +3V3 net; the current unconnected state (U2.1 absent from +3V3 net) shall be resolved.

requirements.source: design context nets: GND lists J1.4, U1.2, U2.5 but not U2.2
requirements.statement: TMP102 U2.GND (pin 2) shall be connected to the GND net; currently only U2.5 (ADD0) is connected to power nets.

requirements.source: workflow: layout_engineer 'solid GND return'; two-layer constraint
requirements.statement: The GND net shall be implemented as a continuous copper pour on the bottom layer providing a continuous return path.

requirements.source: workflow: 'TMP102 on I2C via GPIO21/SDA and GPIO22/SCL'
requirements.statement: The TMP102 I2C bus shall use SDA on U1.GPIO21 and SCL on U1.GPIO22.

requirements.source: TMP102 datasheet supported I2C modes; request: logic at 3.3 V
requirements.statement: The I2C bus shall operate at 3.3 V logic and support 100 kHz standard mode and 400 kHz fast mode clock rates.

requirements.source: workflow: 'add I2C pull-ups'; I2C-bus specification rise-time sizing
requirements.statement: SDA and SCL shall each have a pull-up resistor to +3V3, nominally 4.7 kOhm, sized for target bus capacitance.

requirements.source: NXP I2C-bus specification UM10204
requirements.statement: Total I2C bus capacitance shall remain below the 400 pF I2C specification limit.

requirements.source: design context nets: GND includes U2.5; TMP102 datasheet address table
requirements.statement: TMP102 ADD0 (U2.5) shall be tied to GND, giving I2C address 0x48.

requirements.source: workflow: 'keeping USB differential pair clean'; USB 2.0 specification
requirements.statement: USB D+ (J1.3 to U1.6) and D- (J1.2 to U1.7) shall be routed as a differential pair with matched lengths.

requirements.source: workflow: 'add EN pull-up'; ESP32-WROOM-32 hardware design guidelines; nets: +3V3 includes U1.8
requirements.statement: ESP32 EN (U1.8) shall have a pull-up to +3V3 (nominally 10 kOhm with 100 nF to GND); it shall remain on the +3V3 net as it is today.

requirements.source: pin table: U1.5 GPIO25 present with no net
requirements.statement: Unused GPIO25 (U1.5) shall be left unconnected or assigned a defined function documented in the schematic.

requirements.source: design context: 'Board: 110 x 65 mm (outline 35,35 to 145,100)'
requirements.statement: All components and routing shall fit within the 110 x 65 mm board outline (35,35 to 145,100).

requirements.source: project request: 'stay within a two-layer board'
requirements.statement: The PCB shall use exactly 2 copper layers, with the bottom layer prioritized as ground for return paths.

requirements.source: derived: USB connector mating access requirement
requirements.statement: The USB connector J1 shall be placed at a board edge so the mating cable clears the enclosure keep-out.

requirements.source: derived: TMP102 measures ambient temperature; self-heating/board-heating error mitigation
requirements.statement: The TMP102 (U2) shall be placed away from heat sources (regulator, ESP32) and thermally isolated with copper relief to give minimal measurement error.

requirements.source: derived from MECH-001 and DRC courtyard rules
requirements.statement: No component courtyard shall extend outside the board outline or overhang a board edge.

requirements.source: manufacturer_profile: generic_two_layer; typical 2-layer capability
requirements.statement: Minimum trace width and clearance shall be 0.2 mm per the generic_two_layer manufacturer profile trace width and clearance.

requirements.source: derived: IPC-2221 current capacity for 500 mA on 1 oz copper
requirements.statement: Power traces (VBUS, +3V3) shall be at least 0.5 mm wide for 500 mA with limited temperature rise.

requirements.source: design context: 'ERC baseline: 10 errors, 8 warnings'; workflow: erc_reviewer step
requirements.statement: ERC shall pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings, resolving the baseline of 10 errors and 8 warnings.

requirements.source: design context: 'DRC baseline: 6 errors, 14 warnings'; workflow: drc_reviewer step
requirements.statement: DRC against the generic_two_layer profile shall pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings and with no unrouted nets, resolving the baseline of 6 errors and 14 warnings.

requirements.source: workflow: verification_engineer step
requirements.statement: Verification shall confirm netlist-to-layout consistency (100% netlist-to-layout consistency).

requirements.source: workflow: documentation_engineer step
requirements.statement: Documentation shall include BOM, fabrication outputs (Gerbers/drill), and assembly documentation for the released design.

requirements.source: derived: quality-gate waiver process
requirements.statement: Any ERC/DRC violation that cannot be resolved shall be formally waived with written justification approved by the project manager.
